purpose: Canonical research layer for QQ Bang mechanics, stat fields, synthesis inputs, recipe provenance, and verification.
source_policy: Preserve RNG and recipe uncertainty; never infer an exact result from a community recipe unless the observed six-stat output is documented.

records.name: QQ Bang synthesis system
records.clothing_inputs: Two clothing pieces are combined at the Clothing Mixing Shop.
records.mixing_item: A mixing item is required; Super Mix Capsule Z is used for high-tier QQ Bang research.
records.mixing_location: Capsule Corporation Time Rift Clothing Mixing Shop
records.acquisition_route: Synthesis rather than a direct drop
records.rng_notes: The resulting stat spread is variable; current references describe QQ Bang synthesis as RNG-based, so recipe inputs must be preserved separately from any observed six-stat output.

records.name: Super Mix Capsule Z
records.clothing_inputs: Requires a two-clothing-piece QQ Bang synthesis.
records.acquisition_route: Community-documented high-level Parallel Quest Tour / Expert Mission Tour routes; Super Mix Capsule Z can also be synthesized from a Super Mix Capsule and a Demon Realm Crystal at the Mixing Shop. Exact current drop behavior remains separately verifiable.
records.rng_notes: Super Mix Capsule Z is a six-star mixing item; its use does not guarantee a specific six-stat result.

records.name: Bardock + Beerus clothing recipe family
records.clothing_inputs: Battle Suit (Bardock) and Beerus clothing are repeatedly documented as a high-tier QQ Bang recipe family; exact piece/variant and observed output must be recorded for each attempt.
records.mixing_item: Super Mix Capsule Z commonly documented for six-star attempts.
records.rng_notes: This is a recipe family, not a deterministic six-stat result. Current/community evidence explicitly describes outcome variance; do not promote an expected spread as an observed canonical result.
